prov.heading: Provision for Credit Losses
prov.text:
The provision for credit losses is comprised of the provision for loan losses and the provision for unfunded commitments. The provision recorded in each period represents the amount required such that the total ACL reflects the current estimate of life of loan credit losses in the loan portfolio and the allowance for unfunded commitments reflects the current expected losses on unfunded loan commitments that are expected to result in outstanding loan balances. Our estimate of credit losses is determined using a complex model that relies on reasonable and supportable forecasts and historical loss information to determine the balance of the ACL and allowance for unfunded commitments. Refer also to “Critical Accounting Estimates” in Item 7 of the 2025 Annual Report on Form 10-K filed with the SEC for more information.

The provision for credit losses was $1.3 million and $3.4 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively, and $5.6 million and $6.8 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively. The third quarter of 2026 included a provision for loan losses of $1.4 million and a reversal of provision for unfunded commitments expense of $0.1 million. The third quarter of 2025 included a provision for loan losses of $3.4 million and a provision for unfunded commitments of $0.1 million.

nonint.heading: Noninterest Expenses
nonint.text:
Total noninterest expenses totaled $64.0 million and $60.2 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively, increasing $3.8 million, or 6.3%. This was primarily attributable to a $2.6 million increase in Total personnel expense and a $1.1 million increase in Other operating expenses and $0.5 million of Merger and acquisition expenses recognized in the three months ended September 30, 2026. Total noninterest expenses totaled $187.0 million and $177.0 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively, increasing $10.0 million, or 5.6%. This was primarily attributable to a $7.7 million increase in Total personnel expense and a $1.8 million increase in Software licenses and other software costs.

tax.heading: Income Taxes
tax.text: We recorded income tax expense of $13.3 million and $5.6 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively, resulting in effective tax rates of 20.7% and 21.6%. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, we recorded tax expense of $38.5 million and $27.2 million, resulting in effective tax rates of 20.6% and 22.2%, respectively.

net.text: We earned net income of $51.3 million, or $1.24 diluted EPS, during the third quarter of 2026 compared to net income of $20.4 million, or $0.49 diluted EPS, for the third quarter of 2025 (the "like quarter"). Our increased earnings was driven by a $12.3 million increase in net interest income over the like quarter, resulting primarily from a combination of higher yield on interest earning assets and a lower cost of funds, both of which were driven by the overall interest rate environment throughout the past year. Adjusting for the impact of the $27.9 million loss related to a securities loss-earnback transaction in the like quarter, our adjusted net income, which is a non-GAAP financial measure, was $41.8 million, or $1.01 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2025.

Net interest income.text: • Net interest income for the third quarter of 2026 was $114.8 million, a 12.0% increase from the $102.5 million recorded in the like quarter. There was a shift in the mix of interest-earning assets between periods, with average loans growing $751.5 million, while average taxable securities contracted $173.5 million and short-term investments contracted $190.1 million.

Noninterest income.heading: Noninterest Income
Noninterest income.text:
Total noninterest income for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $15.1 million, a $28.1 million increase from the negative $13.0 million recorded for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The change is primarily attributable to the $27.9 million securities loss due to the securities loss-earnback transaction during the third quarter of 2025.

For the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, total noninterest income was $46.3 million and $14.3 million, respectively. For the year to date periods, the $27.9 million securities loss due to the securities loss-earnback transaction during the third quarter of 2025 accounts for a majority of the change.

intro.text: The Company is the fourth largest commercial bank holding company headquartered in North Carolina. At December 31, 2025, the Company had total consolidated assets of $12.7 billion, total loans of $8.7 billion, total deposits of $10.7 billion, and shareholders’ equity of $1.7 billion. Our principal activity is the ownership and operation of the Bank, a state-chartered bank with its headquarters in Southern Pines, North Carolina, through which we engage in a full range of banking activities. Our principal executive offices are located at 205 SE Broad St., Southern Pines, North Carolina 28387, and our telephone number is (910) 246-2500.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Long-term debt (incl. current portion)
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans, current maturities included: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
